Docs.summary: Provides APIs for classifying text in views.

remarks.para: Use to obtain an . Request objects supply text and context for classification, selection suggestions, link generation, language detection, and conversation action suggestions. Result objects carry the corresponding entities, ranges, links, languages, or actions.

Builders configure requests and results. Selection and classifier events report interactions with features that use text classification. Unless a member documents otherwise, call classifier operations on a worker thread.
